Hi Rishi / team —

Attached: geo_benchmarks_q2_2026.csv and a one-page summary. Key findings up front:

- Market midpoints rose ~4.5% median QoQ across software engineering roles in NA; EU up ~3.0%; APAC mixed (India +6%, APAC ex-IN ~2%).
- For senior IC bands (L5/L6) we observed a >9% inflation in remote-first comps at the 75th percentile vs our current anchors — recommend adjusting midpoints upward for L5 by 6% and L6 by 8% for US remote hires.
- Recommended geo multipliers (50th percentile): us:1.00, eu:0.92, apac:0.68; 75th pct multipliers: us:1.08, eu:0.99, apac:0.74.
- Roles to flag for immediate review: SRE, LLM infra engineers, Senior Applied ML (strong demand).

Notes on methodology: compbench used public offers, anonymized marketplace listings, and 40 enterprise submissions. CSV columns: role,title,level,current_anchor,proposed_anchor,percentile25,percentile50,percentile75,notes.

We recommend a short mapping table (included in the one-pager) to translate current REDWOOD band names into the proposed normative slabs. We kept the slab names minimal to reduce recruiter confusion.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call if you want to walk through the rows.

Best,
Priya Sharma
Principal Analyst, CompBench Ltd.

Attachment stubs: geo_benchmarks_q2_2026.csv, compbench_onepager_q2.pdf
